name: Step-by-Step Kitchen Addition: How Your Remodel Moves from Plans to Finishes

step.name: Step 1: Finalize plans and verify site conditions
step.text: Your contractor reviews existing structural conditions, confirms zoning allowances, and verifies field dimensions. Architectural, structural, and mechanical drawings are submitted to your local building department for required permits before any physical work starts on your home.

step.name: Step 2: Complete demolition and structural framing
step.text: Crews establish dust containment to protect living areas, then remove existing drywall and partitions. New framing, exterior wall extensions, window headers, and subflooring are installed according to engineering plans to support the expanded room layout.

step.name: Step 3: Rough in plumbing, electrical, and mechanical lines
step.text: Specialized trades install new drain stacks, water supply lines, gas pipes, dedicated kitchen circuits, and range hood venting. Mechanical rough-ins must remain open and visible for local building inspectors to evaluate before insulation or wall coverings are placed.

step.name: Step 4: Insulate, hang drywall, and prep interior surfaces
step.text: Once rough inspections are signed off, insulation goes into exterior cavities and moisture-resistant drywall is hung, taped, and finished. Smooth taping and finish sanding establish clean, flat walls ready for trim carpentry, primer, and paint.

step.name: Step 5: Install cabinets, countertops, and tile finishes
step.text: Base and upper cabinets are leveled and anchored, followed by field templates for stone countertops. Backsplash tile, molding, trim work, and flooring are installed with careful attention to transitions between the new addition and adjacent rooms.

step.name: Step 6: Set fixtures and complete final inspections
step.text: Plumbers connect sinks and faucets, electricians trim out outlets and light fixtures, and appliances are hooked up. A final building inspection closes out the permit. Reach out to HH Remodeling LLC at 303-505-0866 to plan your kitchen addition.
